$description: Design tokens (DTCG). Source of truth for the CSS in this directory. Each token records its CSS custom property in $extensions.

border-width.$description: Line widths for border and outline. 1 is the default divider and input border, 2 a selected tab or emphasised edge, 3 a focus ring or accent stripe, 4 a heavy accent bar.

size.$description: Layout widths. container: the max-width of a page or panel's content column, from a card or truncated preview (xs) and a narrow form (sm) to a wide dashboard (xl); dialog: the one width of a dialog, popup or toast. column-min: the narrowest a card may get in an auto-fitting grid, as in minmax(var(--column-min-md), 1fr).

glow.$description: The blur of a coloured glow, as in 0 0 var(--glow-md) var(--color-glow). Only the size: the colour is a role (glow, reward, brand, success) chosen where it is used.

edge-depth.$description: How far the solid 3D edge under a gamified button or card drops, as in 0 var(--edge-depth) 0 var(--color-edge).

shadow-dark.$description: Dark mode for the shadows sm to xl: the same geometry with stronger black, so raised surfaces still stand out on a dark background. Switched on by the skills app's toggle (:root[data-theme='dark']), as color-dark is; the stars app never sets it.
